column1: # Per-package coverage gate. One row per internal package:
# The gate fails when a mapped test package is missing, when a source package
# under daemon/internal is neither mapped nor declared exempt, when a mapped
# test run fails, or when a package measures below its floor.
# The floor is 90 unless a row names its own. A row that names a lower floor
# measured below the target when this mapping was written, so the number
# records where the package actually stands; the target for every package
# stays 90, and a row is raised as its tests catch up.
# A package no test measures is listed as
# so leaving one unmeasured stays a visible decision.
# internal/inference is the canonical request and event vocabulary: plain data
# with no behavior of its own to measure.
# internal/adapters/discovery is exercised through the catalog refresh the
# management integration suite drives, which this gate does not run.
